# strategy

> Return an object containing methods for reshaping an ndarray as a one-dimensional strided array view.

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var strategy = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/kernels/generic/nullary-strided1d-by/strategy' );
```

#### strategy( x )

Returns an object containing methods for reshaping an ndarray as a one-dimensional strided array view.

```javascript
var Float64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/float64' );

var x = {
    'dtype': 'float64',
    'data': new Float64Array( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ] ),
    'shape': [ 1 ],
    'strides': [ 1 ],
    'offset': 0,
    'order': 'row-major'
};

var out = strategy( x );
// returns {...}
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: ndarray [descriptor][@stdlib/ndarray/base/descriptor].

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   The function returns an object having the following properties:

    -   **input**: function providing a strategy for reshaping an input ndarray to a one-dimensional input ndarray view **prior** to applying a one-dimensional strided array function.
    -   **output**: function providing a strategy for reshaping the results of a one-dimensional strided array function to the shape of an input ndarray **after** applying a one-dimensional strided array function. This function should only be invoked for input ndarrays which are written to by the one-dimensional strided array function.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint-disable max-len -->

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var Float64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/float64' );
var ndarray2array = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/to-array' );
var zeros = require( '@stdlib/array/base/zeros' );
var gfillBy = require( '@stdlib/blas/ext/base/ndarray/gfill-by' );
var resolveKernel = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/kernels/generic/nullary-strided1d-by/blocked' );
var strategy = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/kernels/generic/nullary-strided1d-by/strategy' );

function clbk( value, idx ) {
    return ( idx[ 1 ]*100 ) + ( idx[ 2 ]*10 ) + idx[ 3 ];
}

// Create a data buffer:
var xbuf = new Float64Array( 12 );

// Define the array shape:
var xsh = [ 1, 3, 2, 2 ];

// Define the array strides:
var sx = [ 12, 4, 2, 1 ];

// Define the index offset:
var ox = 0;

// Create an input ndarray descriptor:
var x = {
    'dtype': 'float64',
    'data': xbuf,
    'shape': xsh,
    'strides': sx,
    'offset': ox,
    'order': 'row-major'
};

// Create an ndarray descriptor for the starting index (inclusive):
var start = {
    'dtype': 'float64',
    'data': new Float64Array( [ 0.0 ] ),
    'shape': [ 1, 3 ],
    'strides': [ 0, 0 ],
    'offset': 0,
    'order': 'row-major'
};

// Create an ndarray descriptor for the ending index (exclusive):
var end = {
    'dtype': 'float64',
    'data': new Float64Array( [ 4.0 ] ),
    'shape': [ 1, 3 ],
    'strides': [ 0, 0 ],
    'offset': 0,
    'order': 'row-major'
};

// Initialize ndarray descriptors representing subarray views:
var views = [
    {
        'dtype': x.dtype,
        'data': x.data,
        'shape': [ 2, 2 ],
        'strides': [ 2, 1 ],
        'offset': x.offset,
        'order': x.order
    },
    {
        'dtype': start.dtype,
        'data': start.data,
        'shape': [],
        'strides': [ 0 ],
        'offset': start.offset,
        'order': start.order
    },
    {
        'dtype': end.dtype,
        'data': end.data,
        'shape': [],
        'strides': [ 0 ],
        'offset': end.offset,
        'order': end.order
    }
];

// Resolve an input strategy when iterating over subarray views:
var strategyX = strategy( views[ 0 ] );

// Create a workspace array for storing iteration indices:
var ibuf = zeros( xsh.length );

// Define the loop and core dimensions:
var ldims = [ 0, 1 ];
var cdims = [ 2, 3 ];

// Resolve a kernel:
var kernel = resolveKernel( 2 );

// Apply strided function:
kernel( gfillBy, [ x, start, end ], x, views, [ 1, 3 ], [ 12, 4 ], strategyX, ibuf, ldims, cdims, {}, false, clbk, {} );

console.log( ndarray2array( x.data, x.shape, x.strides, x.offset, x.order ) );
```

</section>
